task:
Make the final narrow Review Lab keyboard remediation on draft PR #578 at exact integration head `2afae6477db57a22b9100ff893acaac39d9537b8`. Work only on the existing branch, do not create another PR, do not merge, and do not reintroduce Playwright. Read CLAUDE.md and the acceptance policy first.

Exact evidence: Cypress 15.21.1 `cy.press(Cypress.Keyboard.Keys.ENTER)` focused `open-plan-start` but did not perform the native button default activation in CI. The emitted summary fails at `plan-start-panel` and captures no planner API calls. The button is a standard React `<button onClick>` and works with genuine browser keyboard input under the former Playwright collector. No click fallback or direct handler invocation is acceptable because `alphaKeyboardOpenPlannerWorks` must prove keyboard activation.

Required repair:
1. Add exact devDependency `cypress-real-events@1.15.0` to the temporary React reference frontend and update `yarn.lock` reproducibly. It has no runtime role. Import/register it from `frontend/cypress/support/e2e.js`. Keep ordinary Cypress commands unchanged.
2. In the Review Lab collector only, after focusing the exact single visible `open-plan-start` button and asserting focus, call `cy.realPress('Enter')` (or the package's exact supported Enter syntax) and then assert `plan-start-panel` visible. Do not call `.click()`, `HTMLElement.click`, the React handler, `.type('{enter}')`, or `cy.press()` in this keyboard branch. Mark `alphaKeyboardOpenPlannerWorks` only after the panel opens.
3. Keep Review Lab explicitly Chromium/Chrome because `cypress-real-events` uses CDP and does not support Firefox. Add a fail-closed browser assertion/config guard in the Review Lab runner or collector so an accidental Firefox Review Lab run fails with an intelligible message rather than silently degrading. This does not change the ordinary product parity matrix: `auth-owner-access.cy.js` and `release-gate.cy.js` must still run and pass in both Chrome and Firefox, and must not depend on cypress-real-events.
4. Preserve all existing Cypress-only guarantees: no Playwright; bounded Node-task handshake/output; `allowCypressEnv:false`; exact five viewport/four posture matrix; Delta 503→provenance correlation; accessibility/API/console/overflow evaluators; current Escape and labelled-control fixes; static Stage 26 receipts.
5. Update focused Python/JS contracts to require the pinned plugin, support registration, Review Lab-only `realPress`, Chromium guard, and explicit prohibition of simulated/click fallbacks for planner keyboard activation. Do not weaken evaluator logic.
6. Run frontend install/lint/format/unit checks, ordinary Chrome and Firefox product specs, and full Review Lab verification in Chrome where feasible. Commit through the trusted wrapper to the existing branch. No production, live DB, host, secret, DNS, deployment or recovery action.
